justification: Changes the checker's verdict for rules printed inside pictures: a rule proven by OCR is served as the council's words, so a wrong proof would show text the council did not print.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions quote_status/quote_reason (migration 111); verdicts stay within the existing values (recovered, reason picture_ocr)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: OCR may misread or a page's ordinary text may sit beside a logo; the proof therefore needs the whole rule, in order, inside one picture of 40pt or more
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: applies the next time council_quote runs on a chapter; only rules the text check left unconfirmed are tried
pre_impl.external_source_error: OCR engine missing (rapidocr not installed): the proof is skipped and the rule stays unconfirmed
pre_impl.frontend_type: no frontend change: a recovered rule already shows its quote with the existing note
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: a rule the OCR cannot read fully stays 'Our reading — check the exact wording on page N', never shown as the council's words

functions.name: council_quote_picture.prove
functions.input: the rule's text, the cached chapter PDF path and the rule's stored page number
functions.output: the quote and the page holding the picture when the whole rule (every word, number and comparison symbol, word boundaries kept) appears in order in one picture's OCR text, else None
functions.if_none: the rule keeps its unconfirmed verdict and its 'Our reading' note on the site

values.value: OCR text of each picture on a page
values.guard_at: None when the page has no picture of 40pt+ or OCR is unavailable

break_it.scenario: Words present in the picture but scattered or reordered
break_it.what_happens: a rule the picture does not state would be served as the council's
break_it.how: the whole rule must be one unbroken, ordered stretch of one picture's text

break_it.scenario: The picture lacks a short word such as 'no' or 'not'
break_it.what_happens: the opposite rule would be proven and served as the council words
break_it.how: every word counts, short ones too

break_it.what_happens: a reversed or wrong limit would be served
break_it.how: comparison symbols, % and / are kept and must match

break_it.scenario: A number differs between the rule and the picture
break_it.what_happens: a wrong setback or height would be shown as the council's
break_it.how: numbers are tokens and must match in place

break_it.scenario: A text page carrying only a small council logo image
break_it.what_happens: the page's ordinary text would be OCR-proven through the logo
break_it.how: only pictures of 40pt or more are read, each clipped to itself

break_it.scenario: A two-word drawing label such as 'Rear boundary'
break_it.what_happens: a drawing label would be served as a rule

break_it.scenario: A big chapter has many unconfirmed rules on picture pages
break_it.what_happens: the checker would OCR the same page many times and run slowly
break_it.how: only unconfirmed rules try it and each page is read once (cache per pdf and page)

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a rule with a missing, reordered or changed word, number or symbol, or one outside a picture, is proven
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The first version (word sets) passed the cross-review's scattered-words, missing-'no' and flipped-'<' cases; the new tests failed against it and pass against the ordered match.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Hornsby pilot 2026-10-12: targeted OCR raised proven rules on pages 1-60 from 89% to 92%.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: run council_quote --dry-run on hornsby part 3 and count picture_ocr verdicts
